key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.  One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED
  libraries, or to executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS property set.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
  cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
  CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
root_cause: The ov_generate_plugins_hpp() function in cmake/extra_modules.cmake calls ov_target_link_plugins() which in turn calls target_link_libraries() on MODULE_LIBRARY targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, etc.) when BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF. CMake prohibits linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets into other targets - only STATIC, SHARED, OBJECT, or INTERFACE libraries can be linked. This is a pre-existing CMake configuration regression in the Android build that has appeared 17 times since 2026-08-08. The issue is in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake and is unrelated to the GPU clang-tidy PR changes.
reproduction_steps: Build OpenVINO for Android with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF and multiple plugins enabled to trigger the ov_generate_plugins_hpp() logic.
recommended_actions: Fix cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake to avoid calling target_link_libraries with MODULE_LIBRARY targets - check BUILD_SHARED_LIBS guard in ov_target_link_plugins.
Investigate why this regression appeared around 2026-08-08 and which CMake change introduced it.
This is a pre-existing infrastructure issue unrelated to the current PR - the Android build is broken for all merge-queue PRs.
prevention_strategies: Add a CMake configure-time check that validates plugin targets are not MODULE_LIBRARY when BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF before calling target_link_libraries.
historical_context: Same pattern seen 16 times since 2026-08-08 across multiple PRs. Pattern hash 9ff022172665aa06.
